about: Visual currently applied to the character-editor dummy (queried together with TargetVisualComponent; the creator stores the same defaults as TargetVisual, shifted by 8 bytes). situation 'respec' (Osi.StartRespec on the host, then the character editor's commands, level SYS_CC_I); born together with the other ecl::character_creation components of this batch.

FillTargetVisualComponent increments it when field_0 is set (a change counter). Creator zeroes +4..+0xB. Live 1 (Target), 0 (Current).
FillTargetVisualComponentColorsAndMaterials increments it (change counter of colors/materials). Live 1 (Target), 0 (Current).

open_questions: Member meanings are transferred from TargetVisualComponent (already in the build) by the identical Windows default-store sequence; no Windows function that reads CurrentVisual's members was found (its writers are the macOS-named CharacterCreationVisualSubSystem::Update and EquipmentSubSystem, not paired with bg3.exe functions).

field_10 (one 8-byte zero store at +0x10) and +0xCC (one 8-byte zero store) - their inner split (u64 / pointer / two u32) is not established on Windows; the macOS creator's two 32-bit stores at +0xCC are a hint only.
